title: 風紀委員長賞、受賞者ですから

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One morning at a school assembly…

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Sakura Chiyono O, you are being recognized this month for setting a good example for the other students!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: To name just a few instances, you greeted everyone heartily in the morning, were never late, paid attention in class, and always had all your things with you!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: As such, we're giving you the Disciplinary Committee Chairman's Award! Congratulations!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Th-thank you!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: We hope you will continue to be a fine role model and a paragon of discipline!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Clap, clap, clap…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Ehehe! It feels nice to be praised. Talk about motivation!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Even Bamboo has high hopes for me! I'm going to keep doing my best to protect the peace of the academy!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Booooom!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Gyah! Was that an explosion?! Hang on… There's smoke coming from that classroom!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: You! Stop right there!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Well, well, well. You arrived quicker than I expected, but do you think you can capture me?!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Ngh… I have indeed failed in the past, so I will admit I have my doubts!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Th-this looks like a job for me, the winner of the Disciplinary Committee Chairman's Award!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: But what exactly can I do to help? Uh… Um…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: J-j-jump right in?!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Hang on, what am I hesitating for? I won the Disciplinary Committee Chairman's Award this month. I'm sure I can do this if I try!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Haaahhh! Chiyono O to the rescuuuue!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Whoa!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Sakura Chiyono O takes a flying leap of faith and safely secures Agnes Tachyon.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Nice! You weren't the winner of the award for nothing!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: All right, Tachyon! You're not gettin' out of writing an apology essay this time!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Fine, fine! I'll concede to you today and write one.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Huh? What's that?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: What's what?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: That flickering in the sky. Do you not see what appears to be a glinting light up there?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Hm? I don't see anything…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Wait, is that it? There's some kind of twinkling light over there…

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Isn't that just the sun reflecting off the windows?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Oh, you're right! It is. Hahaha. Sorry!

text_block_list.name: Chiyono O & Bamboo
text_block_list.text: What?!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: I-I can't believe it! She got me again!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Agnes Tachyon gives them the slip several more times after that, but they eventually manage to nab her.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: W-wait, like they do in battles and stuff?!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Hang on, what am I hesitating for? I won the Disciplinary Committee Chairman's Award this month. I'm sure I can do this if I try!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so, they both give chase after Agnes Tachyon.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Y-you're not getting through me!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Oh my, it appears I've been cornered!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Good job, Chiyono O! All right, Tachyon! Give it up! You're not getting away today!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: We've got you now! You can't run anymore!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Now, now, let's all calm down! I'll make us some tea, so let's talk this out!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: It is vital to discuss things. After all, this could be a misunderstanding. You can't just blame people for crimes willy-nilly, right?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Well, uh… Yeah, I guess that's true!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: A wise decision. Now wait here while I fetch some tea leaves.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Okay! We'll be waiting!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Like she said, it's important to hash things out first! Just catching the culprit isn't the only job of the disciplinary committee!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Yeah! Talking things out will be much more productive!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: …She certainly is taking a long time, though. Maybe she can't find the tea.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Is finding tea really this time-consuming?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: I'm not sur—wait.

text_block_list.name: Chiyono O & Bamboo
text_block_list.text: Ahhh!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After that, the academy is thrown into chaos again, and it isn't until the sun is setting that they finally catch Agnes Tachyon.
